notes.title: Full Gamepad Support and UI Update. Patch Note 0.0.2
notes.content: [p]It's time for the promised interface update and full gamepad support.[/p][p]Now you can relax in your chair and fully interact with the game using a gamepad.[/p][p]And also:[/p][p]- The player interface has been globally updated. New design and functionality[/p][p]- The main menu interface has been updated and the functionality of the settings has been expanded[/p][p]- The pause menu interface, traders and other windows have been updated[/p][p]- Now dialogues can be clicked on the "space" button or the gamepad button, without hovering the mouse over the desired answer[/p][p]- Full gamepad support has been added[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939149/580dc4d232f349be7cf3afd539c362bbc43dec96.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939149/d0f4b24ecd563736f130ae0204c134b5a9d5e45c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.1
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939149/c5124cbcebae9fb266bc958c35db9cbb39609faf.png"][/img][/p][code]We would like to thank the players for their feedback. We are gradually making changes to the gameplay and fixing the problems you reported! Thank you! 

Changes in this patch:

- Fixed map control with the mouse
- Now when opening the map, the player is always in the field of view
- Fixed some collisions of objects where the character could get stuck
- Added animation of the player icon on the map for better visibility
- Added a button to reset control settings to default
- Some dialogues in the tutorial level are slightly shortened
- Increased the range of the "Hand of the Wind" ability or pushback
- Fixed an issue where changing the direction of control did not work
- In the control settings, you can now change the button for opening the map (M)
- Added field of view (FOV) setting
- Added setting to disable screen shaking in battle[/code]

notes.title: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness Broadcast
notes.content:
[code]Hello everyone! 
We are glad to see you here! Add the game to your wishlist and launch the demo version![/code]

notes.title: First Meeting
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939149/c5124cbcebae9fb266bc958c35db9cbb39609faf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Welcome to the World of Eclipse![/b][/p][p]Today the demo version of the game became available, and we would like to meet the players and tell them what awaits the project in the future.[/p][p]We are MadRock, a team of enthusiasts creating a game without investors, a publisher or a sponsor. In ordinary life, we have completely ordinary professions and go to ordinary jobs not related to game development. But we always dreamed of creating our own, exciting adventure that players will like.[/p][p][b][i]The demo version available today is not the final version of the game[/i][/b], you will probably encounter a not very user-friendly interface, optimization problems or a number of bugs in the demo. But we will continue to work on improving the game, fixing the problems found. The demo version is presented to the players so that we can better understand the strengths and weaknesses of the game, so that we can understand in which direction we should continue to develop the project and what to focus on. We recommend playing the demo using a keyboard and mouse, because implementing gamepad controls takes more time. According to preliminary estimates, the full version is scheduled to be released in two or three years.[/p][p]BUT, with all the reservations, the demo version contains a full-fledged first large location from the future game, tells the story, allows you to get acquainted with the Eclipse universe and does not impose any restrictions on exploring the world of the game.[/p][p]We hope for your understanding and support![/p][p]Sincerely, MadRock![/p]
